story_grounding: 叔叔家清晨六点，表弟在桌边写作业，叔叔穿外套准备出门，董点事从楼上下楼；桌上两碗白粥和一碟咸菜。夏季东北工业小镇。

Six o'clock on a summer morning inside an ordinary working-class family house in an old Northeast Chinese industrial town. A modest living and dining room, open doorway to a small kitchen at back left, narrow wooden staircase against the rear wall leading upstairs, exterior door at right. Square worn wooden dining table with EXACTLY two bowls of steaming plain rice porridge, one small plate of pickled vegetables and chopsticks. An old sofa, CRT television on a low cabinet, chipped pale plaster walls, worn concrete floor and a faded framed factory-worker award. EXACTLY THREE people with readable full-body proportions: a fourteen-year-old Chinese boy seated at one corner of the table, bent over an open exercise book writing with a pencil; a middle-aged Chinese uncle beside the exterior door, pulling on a faded work jacket before leaving for the repair shop; a young adult Chinese man at the foot of the stairs, just coming downstairs toward breakfast. Clear walking space connects staircase, table, kitchen and exit. Cool pale gray morning daylight enters through a side window, gentle amber light from the kitchen, short soft contact shadows, subtle porridge steam.
